widgets_values: Image 1 is the style reference: a pirate grandpa in hand-painted 2D casual mobile game art. Image 2 is a dark gray silhouette. Draw a new character exactly in the shape of the silhouette in image 2, same position, size and outline: a cute green cartoon turtle sitting on the ground and happily molding a clay jug with its hands. Its head is turned in three-quarter view to the left: the bump on the left side of the head is its snout and smiling mouth, NOT a cheek; the head is not wide, both cheeks are small and equal. Its two eyes sit in the two bumps on top of the head. The rounded shell forms the bulge on the right, one leg stretched forward at the lower left, the clay jug between its legs, held by both hands. Paint it in the same 2D casual style as image 1. Plain flat gray background like image 2, nothing else in the picture.

Repaint the turtle from image 1 in the hand-painted 2D casual mobile game art style of the pirate in image 2: soft painterly shading, subtle texture, gentle warm highlights, thin warm-brown outlines, vivid saturated clean colors exactly as bright as the pirate's purple vest: fresh bright green skin, rich warm terracotta jug, golden-brown shell, warm cream belly, no gray tint, no desaturation, smaller natural eyes like the pirate's, head turned to the left in three-quarter view, small cheeks. Keep exactly the same pose, body shape, outline, size and position, the same clay jug in its hands, the same plain gray background.

Repaint the turtle from image 1 in exactly the same rendering technique as the pirate in image 2, a polished mobile game character illustration: no dark outlines at all, edges defined only by color and light, soft volumetric gradient shading, smooth airbrushed surfaces, glossy specular highlights on the head, shell and jug, only a very faint thin rim light, no glow, no halo, no light outline around the character, warm key light from the upper left. Eyes smaller and more natural with a bright highlight, like the pirate's eyes. Vivid saturated clean colors. Keep exactly the same pose, body shape, silhouette outline, size and position, the same clay jug in its hands, the same plain gray background.

Keep the turtle from image 1 exactly: same pose, body shape, silhouette outline, size, position, face and colors. Change only the jug: it is a jug being hand-molded right now from soft matte terracotta clay, not glossy and not glazed: the rim is slightly uneven and still being shaped between the turtle's fingers, a few soft finger marks on the side. The hands stay clean, only a tiny bit of clay on two fingertips. No clay on the face, no crumbs or drips on the ground, nothing outside the turtle. Painted in the 2D casual mobile game style of the pirate in image 2: soft painterly gradient shading, gentle highlights, no dark outlines, no glow. Same plain gray background.

Keep the turtle from image 1 exactly: same pose, body shape, silhouette outline, size, position, face, eyes, smile, shell and the hand-molded terracotta clay jug with its uneven rim. Fix only these details: the belly is a real turtle plastron - pale yellow-cream bony plates divided into neat segments by thin grooves, part of the turtle's body, not clothing, not a shirt, not a tank top; the arms and shoulders are green turtle skin with soft darker green spots. Each hand is a chubby cartoon turtle hand with exactly four short rounded fingers, clean green, no clay on the fingers, gently shaping the rim of the jug. Painted in the 2D casual mobile game style of the pirate in image 2: soft painterly gradient shading, gentle highlights, no dark outlines, no glow. Same plain gray background.

Keep the turtle from image 1 exactly: same pose, silhouette outline, size, position, face, eyes, smile, hands with four fingers, shell and the hand-molded terracotta clay jug. Fix only: the green skin has just a few small subtle darker green spots on the arms and legs, not many big spots. The neck and throat are green skin all the way down to the chest; the pale yellow plastron with segment grooves starts only at the chest and covers the belly, no neckline, no collar, nothing that looks like clothing. Painted in the 2D casual mobile game style of the pirate in image 2: soft painterly gradient shading, gentle highlights, no dark outlines, no glow. Same plain gray background.
